Privacy and cookies

Your plan and your progress stay on your device.

Data controller

TO COMPLETE — your full name or company name, TO COMPLETE — postal address. Contact:

Your plan and progress

The plan settings, ticked passages and progress are processed only in your browser. They are stored in the page address and in your browser's local storage. They are never sent to our servers.

The child's first name

The first name is optional. If entered, it stays on your device only and is not included in the backup link. It appears on the weekly sheet only if you print or copy it yourself.

Technical logs

Our host (TO COMPLETE — e.g. Cloudflare, Inc.) receives technical data needed to deliver pages and protect the site (IP address, browser type, requested pages, date and time) and keeps it for a limited period. Legal basis: legitimate interest.

Advertising and cookies

The site may be funded by advertising through Google AdSense (Google Ireland Limited). With your consent, Google and its partners may use cookies or similar identifiers to show personalised ads and measure their performance; without consent, non-personalised ads may be shown. In the EEA, the UK and Switzerland, a consent banner lets you accept, refuse or customise these cookies, and you can change your choice at any time. Learn more: how Google uses information from partner sites.

Your rights

Under the GDPR you may access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to and port your data. Write to CNIL).
